From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya@clearlinehealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick check: chargeback owner + security contact for pilot

Hi Priya / Liam — great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and two asks so we can move the pilot forward: 

What we covered (recap):
- Pilot scope: 3-week inference pilot (hosted) for the claims automation POC — ~50k tokens/day expected
- Success criteria: <10% latency regressions compared to baseline, 95th percentile <300ms for inference path; integration with S3 for logs
- Compliance: customer data redaction at ingestion + audit log export

Asks / next steps:
1) Who will be the chargeback / cost owner for this pilot (finance or devops)? We need the billing contact for the Reserved Capacity approval path.
2) Who is the security/compliance owner we should loop in for SOC2 + data residency clarifications?

I've attached a short eval pack and a SOC2 summary to speed the procurement/security review. I'll follow up with a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) that includes timelines and decision checkpoints.

If you can confirm names/emails by EOD Tuesday (11/24) we can lock dates and get the MAP over.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-eval-pack-v1.pdf (12 pages), SOC2-summary.txt (summary, 2 pages)

From: Priya Menon <priya@clearlinehealth.com>

Date: 2026-11-22T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick check: chargeback owner + security contact for pilot

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap. Short answers below and a couple of follow-ups: 

Chargeback / cost owner: Liam O'Connor (CFO) will own the billing approval for pilot spend. Liam — looping you to confirm.
Security/compliance owner: that's me (Priya) for initial reviews; I'll need the formal SOC2 report and a short note on data residency. We may need our security architect (external) involved if there are network/VPC requirements.

Procurement timeline: procurement needs an approved PO and vendor form. If we can get the MAP and the SOC2 report in the next 3 business days, procurement has indicated they can sign off within 7 business days.

Could you also confirm:
- Expected monthly run-rate if pilot scales to production (ballpark)
- Any subprocurement clauses (data processing addendum, subprocessors list)

Thanks — Priya
Priya Menon
Head of Product Ops | Clearline Health
priya@clearlinehealth.com
